nameEn: Manufacture of soft drinks; production of mineral waters and other bottled waters
description: This class includes the manufacture of non-alcoholic beverages, including bottled water, soft drinks, fruit juices and other non-alcoholic drinks.
includes: production of natural mineral water and other bottled waters
manufacture of soft drinks: lemonades, colas, fruit-flavoured drinks
manufacture of energy drinks and sports drinks
manufacture of ready-to-drink teas and coffees
manufacture of syrups and concentrates for soft drinks
excludes: manufacture of fruit and vegetable juices, see 1030
manufacture of wine, cider and other fermented beverages, see 1102
